* #3 spawns 1x [[Bazzzazzt]] (#3) who then spawns [[Bzzzt]] who then spawns [[Bazzt Zzzt]].

They assist and are aggressive but do not see invisible. Proc a poison 100dd. Each has 8x [[Dull Dragon Scale]] as the key loot for this island.
